title: 3.3.9 Context Creation WGL Error - Windows 11 on Parallels for Mac VM

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Bug reports and bugfix pull requests

body:
GLFW 3.3.9 context creation fails to initialize in Windows 11 Parallels VM on Mac with the error "WGL: Failed to retrieve pixel format attributes: The operation completed successfully."

Confirmed latest 3.4.0 commit `b4c3ef9d0fdf46845f3e81e5d989dab06e71e6c1` presents the same glfwinfo error as 3.3.9 build (3.3.9 glfwinfo output listed below).

GLFW 3.3.8 appears to initialize successfully with the same Device/VM configuration - 3.3.8 glfwinfo output listed further below.

Issue appears related to issue discussed in https://github.com/glfw/glfw/pull/2191

**Device/VM Info**
OS and version: `Windows 11 Pro, Version 22H2, OS build 22621.2861, 64-bit operating system, x64-based processor`
VM name and version: `Parallels Desktop 19 for Mac Pro Edition, Version 19.2.1 (54832)`
GPU and driver: `Parallels Display Adapter (WDDM), 4.0 GB, Version 19.2.1.54832`

**GLFW 3.3.9 glfwinfo output**
Release or commit: `e2c92645460f680fd272fd2eed591efb2be7dc31`
Version string: `3.3.9 Win32 WGL EGL OSMesa VisualC`
glfwinfo output:
```
glfw\build-static\tests\Debug>glfwinfo
GLFW header version: 3.3.9
GLFW library version: 3.3.9
GLFW library version string: "3.3.9 Win32 WGL EGL OSMesa VisualC"
Error: WGL: Failed to retrieve pixel format attributes: The operation completed successfully.
```

**GLFW 3.3.8 glfwinfo output**
Release or commit: `7482de6071d21db77a7236155da44c172a7f6c9e`
Version string: `3.3.8 Win32 WGL EGL OSMesa VisualC`
glfwinfo output:
